---
name: attribute-the-real-author
description: A change written by Codex or Gemini credits that model in its PR and commit; Claude is credited only as the orchestrator that opened the job.
metadata:
  type: feedback
---

When a detached Codex or Gemini job writes a change, its PR body and commit name the real author (model and tool). Claude appears only as the orchestrator that opened the job ("Orchestrated-by: Claude Code"), never as "🤖 Generated with Claude Code" or a Claude `Co-Authored-By` trailer.

**Why:** operator, 2026-09-30 ~7:20 PM ET: "All pr I see say generated by Claude, is that correct" — the footer made every Codex/Gemini PR look Claude-written and hid which model did the work, which also skews any per-model quality or cost reading of the PR list.

**How to apply:** delegated-job scripts and the PR body files they use carry the true author; keep the Claude attribution lines only for changes Claude itself wrote. Related: [[worker-model-routing]], [[failure-is-a-product-improvement]].
